detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 video

Agent Skills are exploding. The right response is not panic about 91.8% Defect Rate; it is a better dependency discipline.

GitSkills maps 3.797 million public https://SKILL.md occurrences. A different 138,133-file study reports 91.8% with at least one static reusability finding. Those are not interchangeable numbers, and the latter does not mean 91.8% of skills are malicious or unusable.

#AgentSkills #AIAgents #AIEngineering #DeveloperExperience
